coverage_deep.explantion: Both answers are criticized for being shallow, vague, and lacking concrete examples and detailed mechanisms. consistency_internal.explantion: Response a exhibits fewer and less severe internal consistency problems than response b. Response b, however, has multiple blurred viewpoint issues—including conflating distinct structural factors and merging reciprocal causal pathways—and two attribution failures.
